title: When the Yearbook Burns
author: Bram Fairweather
blurb: Quentin Okafor, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
